text_block.text:
生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, SOLDIERS,
ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME/VILLAGE,
and battle final-frame references.

Keep the same character identities, faces, costumes, weapons,
and environment throughout the video.

Riven uses the exact same sword shown in her reference.

The battle final-frame establishes the current situation:
Riven and Ally are together at the center of a large circle
of SOLDIERS on the mountain road.

They are surrounded from every direction.

Do not recreate the exact wide composition of the reference.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded realistic action.

Natural physical movement.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

Simple cinematic camera movement.

Keep the action clear and easy to understand.

No graphic gore.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Begin much closer than the provided battle final-frame.

A SOLDIER passes close across the foreground,
briefly hiding the frame.

As he passes, reveal Riven and Ally together
inside the surrounding army.

Riven and Ally stay close together,
defending themselves against the SOLDIERS.

Keep the combat brief and simple.


Riven is already exhausted.

During the fight, a strong attack knocks Riven down.

She falls to the ground but remains conscious.

Her sword is still beside her.


One SOLDIER sees the opportunity.

He steps directly toward Riven.

He raises his sword to strike her while she is down.


Ally sees what is about to happen.

He immediately shouts:

"RIVEN!"


The SOLDIER swings his sword toward Riven.


Ally instantly rushes between them.

He deliberately uses his own body to protect Riven.

Ally takes the strike that was meant for Riven.


Only Ally is hit.

Only Ally collapses.

Riven is not hit.

The surrounding SOLDIERS remain standing normally.


Ally loses his strength and falls toward Riven.

Riven immediately catches him.


Keep the camera focused on Riven and Ally.

Riven holds Ally in her arms.

She realizes that he sacrificed himself to save her.


Riven quietly asks:

"Why?"


Ally looks at her weakly.

He answers:

"You would've done the same."


Ally dies in Riven's arms.


Riven remains holding him.

The other SOLDIERS remain standing in the surrounding area.

They do not collapse.

Do not show any other character falling or dying.


After a quiet moment,
Riven slowly looks into the distance.


Far across the valley,
thick dark smoke rises from the direction of her home village.

A distant orange fire glow is visible beneath the smoke.

Her home village is burning.


Riven stares at the distant fire.

Then she slowly looks back down at Ally.


Still devastated,
Riven carefully lowers Ally's body onto the ground.

Riven remains beside him.

CUT.、16:9
